name: Ochre Jackal
prompt: One hand-painted stylized fantasy MMORPG creature asset for Elyndra. Ochre Jackal: a rangy jackal with ochre fur, huge ears, a dark stripe down the spine and a brass tag from a long-gone caravan on its collar. Lean elegant desert canine, large pointed ears, sandy ochre fur, pale throat, dark dorsal stripe, narrow intelligent muzzle, worn leather collar with small aged brass caravan tag, no writing. Strict FULL BODY FRONT orthographic eye-level: nose, sternum and pelvis all aligned on central vertical axis, both shoulders square to camera, all four natural canine legs with rear paws peeking behind forepaws. NOT three-quarter body. Natural neutral standing stance, tail mostly behind body with small tip visible beside hind leg. Detailed painterly fur with clear large shapes and warm soft shading, Ragnarok / Tree of Savior fantasy aesthetic. Full ears and paws visible with generous transparent margin on square canvas. Transparent background, no ground, no cast shadow, no backdrop glow, no text or props.
